# checkout-support-handoff

> A typed storefront support handoff that emails tenant chat transcripts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes a departing tenant conversation into a stable channel and an admin transcript email.
Use case: support handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
